sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 210. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 100% of max HP.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 8 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 50 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Boosts stats of light Monsters by 20% when equipped in the Main Slot.
